body:
A little backround information: Im a 135 lbs. white male, took them with another 160 lb. male who well call A.
I am a heavy marijuana smoker, drink when its available, and at this time I had tried ecstasy twice, lortabs twice, morning glory (LSA) twice, amanita muscarias, salvia, and they were all enjoyable experiences, except for salvia.
A has extensive experience with marijuana, cocaine, all sorts of prescription pills, acid, shrooms, morning glory, amanita muscarias, and other stuff.
Me and A were staying at his house and were going to take them and just chill when his parents went to sleep.
I take one and a half green monsters 1mg Klonopins, as does A, with a good little bit of pot.
The pot somewhat masked the coming up until I got up from smoking a cigarette and realized that walking was not a good idea.
Me and A did random things for about an hour and a half, just watched tv and played video games and such.
I would go into more detail, but honestly my memory of the night was messed up six ways to Sunday.
About two hours after the initial dose, we decide to take another half, and as we go to get the pills, A suggests insufflation to get to the next level.
Ive never snorted anything, but I was pretty fucked up at this point; if I had to describe it I would say it was like taking a moderate dose of hydrocodone, taking 5 or 6 shots of hard liquor back to back, smoking a fat blunt of good weed, and having each of my limbs develop their own individual minds; I would be walking through a doorway to seemingly forget that my arm was there and knock my arms/hands/shoulder against the door frame.
After snorting it, I honestly dont remember shit except walking around and smoking blunts.
The next day, I felt like I woke up drunk as piss, but it was a very enjoyable feeling to be honest, not too intense at all; the only unpleasant part was that Im one of those people who can is usually able to concentrate and control themselves when needed when theyre drunk, and I couldnt live this one down, I was seeing double, and stumbling all over the place.
In fact, Ill never forget when another friend who had taken the k pins that same night just not with us (he took 4 over the course of the night, but stayed up longer than us) was hanging out with me the next day when he was standing up, and his phone in his pocket went off, and he was still so messed up that when he reached into his pocket to check his phone he lost his balance and stumbled back four or five steps into my garage door.
All in all, it was an enjoyable experience, you just have to be ready for it. If you take a moderate dose, dont plan on driving around anywhere; also, I didnt have to do this, but Im sure talking to parents/cops/authority figures would have sucked bad because I know I was slurring my words too.
